title: Secret Codes
statement: A message of letters was turned into digits with A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26 and the digits were written with no spaces. Return how many different letter messages the digit string could have come from. The answer fits in a 32-bit integer.

answerKey.pattern: 1-D DP over prefixes: ways(i) = ways(i − 1) if the last digit is 1–9, + ways(i − 2) if the last two digits are 10–26
keyPoints: A single digit 0 cannot stand alone
Two digits count only from 10 to 26

hints: Look at how the last letter of the message was written: one digit or two.
One digit works if it is 1–9; two digits work if they form 10–26.
Keep ways for the last two prefixes and combine them.
